# NORDVIA EXPORTS

NORDVIA EXPORTS is a Sialkot, Pakistan-based apparel sourcing and manufacturing business. We work with manufacturing partners to discuss and coordinate custom apparel development, private-label requirements, and export arrangements for international brands and buyers.
